main_text.l: ferant: tributa ab omnibus provincialibus
exigant severè, & nusquam conniventes,
eaque in nullum finem alium, quàm in quem
destinata sunt, impendant; tributorum one-
rumve aliorum nihil sine consensu & man-
dato Ordinum populum poscant, hoc verò
agant sedulò, ut qui Reip. tributi aliquid re-
siduì debent, si quàm maturimè ad id solven-
dum compellantur. Porro cùm quid cuiquam
solvendum decernent, consignent hoc mani-
bus suis si non omnes, saltem bini ex op-
pidanis, & totidem ex agrariis, & subsi-
gnet scriba à secretis, ifque decretum hoc sta-
tim in volumen actorum referat: secùs si quid
h ujus generis fiat, id in reddendis rationibus
locum non habeat. Idem collegæ [?] deputati
in eo sint, ut qui Reip. militant, iis stipen-
dia integrè singulis quadrimestribus aut die-
bus CXXV I solvantur:curent quoque, ut quod
cohortium præfeētis [?] numeratur in stipendia
militum, hoc militibus statim pendatur sine
fraude, sine quæsito eâ in re ullo quæstu,
utque in eos, qui contra delinquere depre-
hensi fuerint, animadvertatur graviter, sive
exautoratione, sive aliâ pœnâ graviore: hocq;
observetur etiam hac in re, ut stipendii re-

page.notes: Printing errors left as printed: "h ujus" (space inside the word), "CXXV I", "solvantur:curent" (no space after colon). "colleg.e" and "præfeētis" are doubtful readings; the ligature in "præfeētis" and the spelling of "collegæ" are uncertain, so they are marked [?]. The page appears to continue a paragraph from the previous page and the text ends mid-word at "re-", with "siduum" as the catchword. The printed "Vrbe" in the running head was changed to "Urbe" under the u/v rule. A faint digitiser stamp at the lower right is excluded.
